suggest、demand、insist 后的虚拟: 建议、要求、命令、坚持类动词后的 that 从句用 (should) + 动词原形,不受时态影响。

一类动词:suggest, demand, insist, require, request, order, propose, recommend|从句谓语:should + 原形,should 常省略,只剩原形|主句过去时也不改变:She insisted that he be told.|相关名词(suggestion, demand)后的同位语从句同样用原形|insist on being right(坚持观点)不用虚拟:insist that he was honest
The doctor suggested that he (should) cut down on caffeine.
column3: 医生建议他少摄入咖啡因。

suggest、demand、insist 后的虚拟: She demanded that the contract be rewritten.
The panel recommended that the funding be extended.
It is essential that everyone arrive on time.
column3: 每个人准时到场至关重要。

suggest、demand、insist 后的虚拟: My request that he wait outside went ignored.
column3: 我请他在外面等的要求被无视了。

# title: The board demanded that the report ___ before Friday.
column4: demand 后的从句用 (should) be done,选 be submitted。

# title: She suggested that he ___ the client first.
column4: suggest 后从句用原形 call。

# title: It is vital that no one ___ the results early.
column4: It is vital that... 后用原形 announce。

# title: The general ordered that the bridge ___ .
column4: order 后从句用被动原形 be destroyed。

suggest、demand、insist 后的虚拟: The rule requires that each player wear a number.|The rule requires that each player wears a number.|The rule requires that each player is wearing a number.|The rule requires that each player wore a number.
column4: requires that + 主语 + (should) wear 原形。

# title: The manager insisted that the deadline ___ , and he was right to.
suggest、demand、insist 后的虚拟: not be moved|was not moved|not moved|would not be moved
column4: insist 表"坚决要求"时从句用 not be moved。
